thread:
Alex Chen: :rotating_light: paging oncall — production error spike after today's rollout. Pods in payments-canary are crashlooping, 503s to /charge. https://dashboard.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-321
Maria Gonzalez: I'm seeing replicas go from 3 -> 0 in a few minutes, HPA scaled down then crashed. logs show OOMKilled on the new image.
Samir Patel: noted. What was in the canary? small change to db connection pool + feature flag ramp for fast-retries.
Tier 1 Oncall: I'm on it, taking lead. starting investigation now.
deploy-bot: Deploy event: canary rollout v2.14 -> payments-canary started by @Maria at 2026-03-15T14:05Z.
Alex Chen: stack traces in the first crash: 
```
panic: runtime: out of memory
goroutine 1 [running]:
main.main()\nkubectl logs payments-canary-5f7d6 -n prod | tail -n 50
```
Maria Gonzalez: HPA config change looks suspicious: targetCPUUtilizationPercentage was lowered to 20 for canary. That caused aggressive scale downs under bursty load.
Samir Patel: Wait, lowering target -> HPA scales up more, why scale down? maybe wrong metrics — it's wired to custom metric `active-requests` that returned 0 after dropping due to crash. so HPA downscaled to 0 and then restart churn.
Tier 1 Oncall: Customer impact: several merchants reported failures to create charges between 14:06 - ongoing. Paging SRE and Prod Eng.
incident-bot: Incident opened INC-321 (critical) — page sent to #oncall with escalation.
Alex Chen: Can we pause the feature flag ramp? LD link: https://launchdarkly.com/toggle/feature/fast-retries — turning to 0% should stop the new codepath.
Maria Gonzalez: I'm toggling the flag now.
Maria Gonzalez: toggled 100% -> 0% :white_check_mark:
Samir Patel: Nice. That should reduce pressure. But the canary pods will still be on the bad image. Recommend rollback of the canary to previous replicaSet or scale to 0 and recreate.
Tier 1 Oncall: Agreed. Deploy-bot can we force rollback?
deploy-bot: Command: `/deploy rollback payments-canary --to-revision v2.13 --force` queued by @Tier 1 Oncall.
Alex Chen: Before rollback — let's put a kill-switch: annotate the canary service to route 100% traffic to stable. Ingress rule update?
Samir Patel: On it: `kubectl patch svc payments -n prod -p '{"spec": {"selector": {"app":"payments-stable"}}}'` doing a gradual shift.
Maria Gonzalez: Also manually cordon problematic nodes where crashloops originated: nodes/ip-10-2-5-7 and ip-10-2-5-8 showed repeated OOMs.
Tier 1 Oncall: Cordon + drain plan: `kubectl cordon ip-10-2-5-7 && kubectl drain ip-10-2-5-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` — be careful, some statefulsets.
k8s-bot: Node drain started for ip-10-2-5-7 by Maria Gonzalez at 14:22Z.
Alex Chen: Drain failed on 5-7: `error: eviction API failed: cannot evict pod because discretionary pod disruption budget would be exceeded`. That suggests we have very small budgets on payments.
Samir Patel: If PDBs block drain, we can scale the stable replica count up temporarily so drain can proceed safely. Increasing payments-stable to 5 from 3.
Maria Gonzalez: Scaling now: `kubectl scale deployment payments-stable --replicas=5 -n prod`
Tier 1 Oncall: Rollback completed by deploy-bot: payments-canary rolled back to v2.13 at 14:25Z.
deploy-bot: Rollback logs: successful rollout, new replicaSet stable.
Alex Chen: Observability: latency for /charge now trending down but error rate still slightly elevated. Hoping double-checking LB routing worked.
Samir Patel: Crashloops stopped after rollback and flag kill. Reviewing heap profiles — new image had an aggressive cache population causing memory explosion under certain request patterns. Will open PR to cap cache.
incident-bot: Postmortem placeholder created: https://dashboard.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-321/postmortem — assigned to @Samir.
Tier 1 Oncall: Customer comms: can someone draft a short note about what happened and that we rolled back and toggled the flag? I'll coordinate with CS.
Maria Gonzalez: I'll draft and post to #customer-impact.
Alex Chen: Lessons for runbook: add a pre-rollout HPA check to validate metric wiring, ensure feature flag ramp has a quick kill lane, and require memory/smoke tests for canary image.
Samir Patel: Follow-up action items: (1) revert HPA misconfig change, (2) add metric sanity check to rollout pipeline, (3) patch image to cap cache, (4) review PDB sizes. I'll take 1 & 3.
Tier 1 Oncall: Handoff — I'm staying on-watch for 30m then handing to next oncall @Samir.
Samir Patel: I can take it. I'll watch errors and confirm customer symptoms cleared.
Maria Gonzalez: Customer note posted. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Thanks all. Closing alert but keeping incident open for postmortem until tomorrow.
incident-bot: Incident INC-321 status: mitigated -> monitoring.
Tier 1 Oncall: last check: 14:42Z, error rate near baseline, no active P0s. I'll update timestamps and close oncall handover at 14:47Z.
Samir Patel: Confirming stable at 14:52Z — moving to post-incident review.
